text:
maria (partnerships): Quick ask — I'm re-running the HW cost model for Marketplace pricing and need concrete inputs from Zenith + Aurora by EOD. Specifically: spot availability curves by region, reserved tenor + discount tiers, SKU-level listing fees (rev share vs flat), any minimum commit windows, and how burst/ephemeral allocations are billed. Can folks paste numbers or tag vendor contacts? Thanks.

alex (finance): Do we have last-quarter realized utilization/spot %s? even rough ranges will speed modelling.

sam (supply ops): Zenith notes: spot availability by region typically ~10-45% (EMEA lower, US-west higher). Price dispersion peak spot->on-demand ~1.6–1.9x. Reserved discounts they publish: 1mo=5%, 3mo=10%, 12mo=20% off on-demand baseline. Marketplace listing: 0.5% revenue share + $0.02/hr per SKU registration. No hard min commit but 3mo preferred for those discounts.

diego (vendor-relations): Aurora input: spot deeper in APAC, ~25–70% availability pre-COVID normal; preemptions occur in bursts and affect tail latency. Reserve discounts: 1mo 7%, 6mo 15%, 12mo 28% (H100/A100 families). Listing fee typical is 1% rev share but we can negotiate to 0.3% at volume tiers. They dropped a sheet here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Aurora-Zenith-Inputs

priya (infra): Can we get SKU unit prices? e.g. H100-80GB on-demand, A100-80GB, etc. Need to map to our perf curves for cost per token.

jen (partnerships): pinging contacts now — asking for quarterly forward curves (availability by quarter) and any minimum notice for commit changes. :eyes:

oliver (marketplace): FYI listing fee is usually a revenue share on usage billed through marketplace. Some partners add a fixed monthly SKU registration fee ($300–$750) as a separate line item.

sam (supply ops): quick CSV example I'll paste as a minimal template to fill: 
```
partner,region,gpu,od_usd_hr,reserve_1m, reserve_3m, reserve_12m,spot_pct_q1,spot_pct_q2
Zenith,us-west,H100-80GB,3.20,3.04,2.88,2.56,0.40,0.30
Aurora,apac,A100-80GB,2.40,2.23,2.04,1.73,0.60,0.50
```

diego (vendor-relations): Suggest we also add a shock scenario: spot collapse to ~5% for 2–4 weeks in a region (e.g., holiday batch windows). Model both baseline and tail-risk for pricing ops.

alex (finance): :thumbsup: I'll run sensitivity runs for blended unit cost and a worst-case capacity surcharge. Can everyone paste final numbers in this thread? I'll slot results into the cost model.

maria (partnerships): If exact numbers aren't available, approximate bins are fine (low/med/high availability + discount bands). Also confirm if listing fee is % of revenue or per-hour add-on — partners vary and it materially affects gross margin. Need final inputs by 16:30 PT today. :clock3:
